items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: And so then we look down here at the Million Dollar Room, which was owned by Mr. Curry.

ctx.x: Right. And his daughter later took the club over today. It's a shadow of the past that was the glory of Club Tijuana at South Saratoga near Calayo. And incidentally, I passed through there about five or six months ago and I took pictures of the place the way it is today because I'm contemplating on working on a book sometime this year with the help of the good Lord. Well, some of this material will be utilized and you will be given your credits. No doubt about it. Well, I've got to, Ted, because you've got to…
Well, I want you to look at this, the Tijuana Club ad. Is this kind of representative? I'm looking at these two people. Is this kind of representative?
